title: Fan-in of the program circuit
statement: For any natural numbers $n,m,w$, any type of instruction kinds with a designated default, any function assigning to each kind a Boolean-list function, any program of instructions, and any indices $i,j$, the circuit built from the program with output indices $i,j$ is well formed, has no repeated input to any gate, uses exactly one input for each NOT gate, and every gate has at most two inputs.
